name: gen_lin_sylvester_rank_rect
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n p : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K) : Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B ≤ Fintype.card n + Matrix.rank (A * B)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n p : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K), Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B ≤ Fintype.card n + Matrix.rank (A * B)
informal: Generalizes Mathlib2.lin_sylvester_rank: ℝ → arbitrary field K, square Fin n matrices → rectangular matrices A : m×n, B : n×p over arbitrary Fintypes. Proof idea: the original proof (rank-nullity for A.mulVecLin and for its restriction to range B.mulVecLin) never uses ℝ or squareness.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (m : Type u_2) (n : Type u_3) (p : Type u_4) [Fintype m] [inst_2 : Fintype n] [inst_3 : Fintype p] (A : Matrix m n K) (B : Matrix n p K), A.rank + B.rank ≤ Fintype.card n + (A * B).rank
